name: labs/nsls-ii-chx__syringe_pump_controller
title: NSLS-II CHX syringe pump controller
intro: NSLS-II CHX syringe pump controller, adapted from nsls-ii-chx/syringe_pump_controller. It reads `direction` and `dispensed_volume`; sets `flow_rate` and `volume`; runs `dispense` and `stop_pump`. `dispense`: run a pump at a declared flow rate for a declared duration or volume in a declared direction, reporting the volume moved. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
